reviews.text: We went there twice and they did a great job treating my cat. Very expensive though. The first time we spent ~ €1000 and they sent us a bill. Very pleasant experience. The second time they charged €600 to clean her teeth and they said they couldn't send us the bill. Kinda a weird way to treat a returning customer tbh... so I'm a kinda salty 😅

We went to two different places before Felina and got the wrong diagnosis and spent thousands of euros, until the lovely Teija at Felina took our cat's situation seriously and thoroughly explained what caused all the symptoms. I can highly recommend her❤️
Teija is an incredibly gentle and skilled doctor. Our senior cat has always been afraid of vets, but under Teija's care, he relaxes and shows love in the same way he does at home ❤️

We had trouble getting a diagnosis for our cat elsewhere, but at Felina, the very knowledgeable doctor was able to run the right tests and make a diagnosis. We've been going here for years now, and I can recommend it without hesitation.
You won't get such good care for your cat anywhere else than here!

Felina and Teija are not to be praised for nothing, even the first visit was in a completely different sphere than anywhere else! Unfortunately, we have been to MANY different doctors with Aava and Teija is definitely the best of them all. After our first visit to the vet, we felt like we had been really listened to and that the causes of the symptoms were not just guessed at, but were really being investigated and thoroughly investigated. The only downside is that we didn't come earlier :)
Friendly staff and very helpful with everything 😊 …

The nice and friendly staff provide excellent service! But at the same time, they are scammers because they are trying to extort money. I recommend that after the decisions of the Felina veterinarians, you also check the diagnoses and information with other specialists. For example, about three years ago we were told that our pet urgently needed to have tartar removed. We went to another veterinarian, who said that there was no need for it to be removed – there was not even tartar. Later, a couple of years later, at the Evedencia in Touse, we were told again that tartar does not need to be taken care of for another 1-2 years, because it is just plaque, not tartar. Be careful!
The cat's surgery was successful and professional. Thank you to Iine and Camilla for the good service and advice!
Very knowledgeable and friendly staff. My shy and sensitive rescue dog received good care and his special needs were taken into account. Highly recommended in every way!
I received really good care with my kitten, both in an emergency and in sterilization. Everything went great ❤️special thanks to doctor Iines for the very good care and meeting❤️

Not the cheapest, but the best. The specialization in cats is really visible and we have always received excellent care. Our cat was diagnosed with inflammatory bowel disease here and it was a relief to finally get the cause of the symptoms, as we had previously gone elsewhere.

We have been able to get the disease under control and the clinic generally has a high level of knowledge about feline diseases, e.g. inflammatory bowel disease and lymphoma.

Last year I became a cat mom to two beautiful boys. Very pleased with Felina’s service and care for my boys. Both my boys enjoy coming to the vet and I am certain is it because of the friendly veterinarians.

I believe I have the right to speak about Felina, as my cat Yongyong has been receiving treatment there for over a year. Yongyong suffers from kidney failure and anemia. In January 2023, two doctors at another veterinary clinic suggested that I euthanize Yongyong because her anemia was severe, and she refused to eat. They believed that even with treatment, she would only survive for a few months at most.

However, after transferring to Felina, the doctors there tailored different treatment methods specifically for Yongyong's condition. Now, Yongyong is doing much better and even occasionally causes a bit of mischief at home. I am incredibly grateful to Teija for pulling Yongyong back from the brink of death. The other doctors and nurses at Felina have also been very kind and supportive.
